iterations.explanation: New batch adds: MVC UI control, Observer UI updates, Adapter-based multi-provider maps, and standard credential validation. To keep axes orthogonal under 5 dimensions, Observer is grouped with UI control patterns (dimension 3) rather than creating a new eventing dimension. The credential validation item fits the existing authentication/security axis (dimension 2). Adapter integration fits the external-provider abstraction axis (dimension 5). No repository or onboarding-specific splits were required.
